name: Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon (5th ed.)
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Hanoi, Vietnam, featuring a full marathon among six distance options, scheduled for October 4, 2026.
ai_summary: The Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon returns for its 5th edition on October 4, 2026, in Hanoi, Vietnam. The event offers six distance options, from a full marathon (42.195km) down to a short 1.5km fun run, catering to a wide range of participants. The marathon and half marathon start at the Đền Bà Kiệu garden on Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street by Hoàn Kiếm Lake, and the one-way course finishes at Vinhomes Riverside in Long Biên.

core_facts.venue: Start: Đền Bà Kiệu garden, Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street, Hoàn Kiếm; finish: Vinhomes Riverside, Long Biên

pros: AIMS-certified one-way course from Hoàn Kiếm through the Old Quarter and around West Lake, over Nhật Tân and Đông Trù bridges
Generous cut-offs: 6 hours 30 for the marathon, 4 hours for the half
Deep field: 41 marathoners under three hours in 2025
Early starts: marathon at 4am, half marathon at 4.30am
cons: Hot and humid: 26°C with a 25°C dew point at the 2025 start, 32°C by the marathon cut-off
Only 87% of 2025 marathon starters finished officially
One-way course: the finish is in Long Biên, across the river from the start, so plan transport
Dark, easily confused turns through the Old Quarter and West Lake before dawn
No refunds, and bibs cannot be transferred
research_highlights: The course runs through Hanoi's heritage and cultural landmarks, including the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the National Assembly, and Long Bien Bridge.
All four distances (42.195km marathon, 21.097km half marathon, 10km, and 5km) are AIMS-certified courses, also recognized by the Vietnam Athletics Federation.
The 2025 (4th) edition drew over 13,000 runners from 55 countries and territories, according to Nhân Dân's post-race report, about 1.5 times the previous year's field.
On race morning in 2025 (5 October) Noi Bai airport recorded 26°C and 94% humidity with mist at the 4am start, rising to 32°C by 10am.

The event is organized by Sunrise Events Vietnam (also organizers of IRONMAN Vietnam) with Techcombank as title sponsor, and includes a 'Marathon Village' with expo activities in the days before the race.
research_watchouts: High humidity (around 90%) reported on race morning in October, which can make conditions muggy despite moderate air temperature.
As a large, fast-growing event (13,000+ participants and increasing year over year), expect crowded start corrals and busy heritage-route sections near central landmarks.

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The 5th edition of the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon takes place on Sunday 4 October 2026, according to the official site and AIMS. The marathon starts at 4am from the Đền Bà Kiệu garden by Hoàn Kiếm Lake, with a 6 hour 30 minute limit, and finishes at Vinhomes Riverside in Long Biên.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this marathon?
faqs.answer: The race offers six distance options to accommodate different runner levels: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, plus 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km races. The 42.195km full marathon serves as the primary featured distance of the event.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the race start in Hanoi?
faqs.answer: The marathon starts at the Đền Bà Kiệu garden on Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street, beside Hoàn Kiếm Lake. The course is one-way: it runs through the Old Quarter and around West Lake, crosses Nhật Tân Bridge into Đông Anh, returns over Đông Trù Bridge and finishes at Vinhomes Riverside in Long Biên, across the river.
